stories.summary: After five days of labour unrest, the situation eased on 6 November as workers returned to garment factories and production resumed across the industrial belts. Normalcy largely returned to Gazipur, Narayanganj and Mirpur, though tensions persisted in parts of Ashulia and Savar. On Friday, about 35 percent of garment factories in Gazipur were open, police said, and the overall situation was normal, with some factories announcing a two-day closure over the weekend.

stories.summary: The government unveiled a comprehensive plan to rebuild the healthcare system, allocating a record Tk 694.09 billion to the health sector this fiscal year — 7.4 percent of the national budget. Using Enigio's solution, the banks electronically created and transferred original trade documents, including an electronic bill of lading and a digital promissory note. The digital process improved transaction visibility and document security, reducing the risks of documents being lost, delayed or altered.
